☁ One-time sync setup — the same URL on laptop and mobile
  1. Open script.google.com → New project → delete everything → paste the code (button below) → Save.
  2. Deploy → New deployment → Web app → Execute as Me, Who has access Anyone → Deploy → Authorize.
  3. Already using the old script? Deploy → Manage deployments → Edit → New version (paste the new code first).
  4. Paste the Web app URL (ends with /exec) below and press Connect & Sync — on this device and on your other device.
Both apps (Defect Report + Daily Patrol Report) save to the same Drive folder. Changes made on one device appear on the other within about 10–20 seconds. If both devices edit the same report at the same moment, the one saved last wins. Keep the URL private.
⌨ Keyboard shortcuts — Quick Report Hub
Everywhere
Alt + Shift + 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 → Defect / Patrol / ER2 Tower Data / Thermovision Report
Alt + Shift + R → Refresh other device (phone ⇄ PC)
? or F1 → help for the open page
Ctrl + S → save now
Enter → Done / Next field (works on the phone keyboard too)

Defect Report
Alt+N add row · Alt+A select all · Alt+Shift+A clear · Alt+1…9 switch sheet · Alt+↑/↓ move row · Alt+C copy to other sheet · Alt+M move to other sheet · Alt+W new sheet · Alt+H hide/delete sheets · Alt+L edit line list · Alt+X Excel · Alt+P PDF · / or Ctrl+K search

Daily Patrol Report
Alt+N add row · Alt+L add line · Alt+X Excel · Alt+J JPG · Alt+P PDF · Alt+W WhatsApp
⚠ Photo / PDF + caption sharing is blocked on this page. It was opened from a content:// link, which Chrome treats as not secure, so it cannot hand files to WhatsApp. Fix once: put this file on an https:// page (GitHub Pages / Netlify Drop) and open that link in Chrome. Until then: the file downloads, the caption is copied, WhatsApp opens — attach the file (📎) and paste the caption.
